previous-holder.Spiral/Ateri@379YE Winter: The report says the Grendel had only part-occupied Ateri; the 379YE Autumn report has it still Urizen-held, so it never changed hands at a summit.
previous-holder.Kahraman/Serra Briante@380YE Autumn: Seized by the Jotun after the Summer Solstice and retaken before the Autumn Equinox, so it was Brass Coast at both summits.
previous-holder.Liathaven/Western Scout@381YE Spring: The 'Navarr' held only a beachhead (the report: 'perhaps never fully Navarr-held'); Jotun held the region from 379YE Winter.
previous-holder.Madruga/Lightsea@382YE Spring: The 381YE Winter report says the Grendel took the east coast but not the whole region, so Lightsea stayed Brass Coast.
previous-holder.Mournwold/Alderly@382YE Winter: The territory page's Feni in Alderly's deep woods were driven out, but the reports had the Marches holding every region of Mournwold from 381YE Winter.
previous-holder.Bregasland/Grey Fens@384YE Summer: The 384YE Summer overview restates the Jotun conquest the spring report had already recorded (383YE Autumn).
previous-holder.The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht@387YE Sprin: The territory page confirms the Great Forest Orcs hold it by treaty; the report 'Ripples and shadows' dates their taking it to 385YE Winter, which the map follows.
